subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Should this PR be redesigned around the additive negotiated request-cancellation capability described in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/103980, including pending/effecting/completed state?
rationale: The existing client timeout is local and a persistent WebSocket close event cannot represent one request's cancellation; the authoritative protocol and late-cancel semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Redesign this PR
options.body: Retain this PR as the candidate fix but replace the socket-close shortcut with additive request-scoped cancellation and explicit lifecycle state.

options.title: Implement separately
options.body: Pause or close this branch and leave the canonical issue open for a dedicated gateway protocol repair.

recommendation.title: Redesign this PR
recommendation.body: Retain this PR as the candidate fix but replace the socket-close shortcut with additive request-scoped cancellation and explicit lifecycle state.
